**Root cause:** This morning's deploy of **payments-api v5.1.0** was running degraded in production across all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate** — it was the only known-healthy predecessor version I could find, so I rolled back to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production.

**Actions taken:**
1. ✅ **Rolled back payments-api to v5.0.0** across all production regions.
2. ✅ **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** — "payments-api degraded after v5.1.0 deploy" — and the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Current state:** payments-api is now on v5.0.0 across all regions, **healthy, with a 0.2% error rate** — consistent with its pre-deploy baseline.

**Note:** The incident creation call initially timed out, so I retried it with the same idempotency key to confirm it was created (it was — INC-0001 now shows as open and paged), without creating a duplicate incident.
